name: 0DTE Long Put Scalp
summary: The bearish mirror of the 0DTE call scalp: buy a near-ATM put on expiration day for a short, mechanical downside momentum burst.

legs.strike_rule: Delta -0.40 to -0.55 (ATM to one strike OTM)

max_profit: Bounded by strike x 100 - debit; realistically 30-100% of debit on a clean flush
max_loss: Debit paid x 100; assume full loss on every stop

greeks.theta: catastrophic, same profile as the 0DTE call
greeks.vega: positive; unlike calls, downside moves usually come with an IV bid, which helps the put

when_to_use: Downside momentum days. Puts have a structural edge over calls in 0DTE scalping because a selloff expands IV (vega tailwind) while a rally crushes it.
entry_rules: Trigger: 5-minute close below the opening range low AND below VWAP, bar volume >= 1.5x the 20-bar average
Optional confirmation: VIX up >= 3% on the day
Delta -0.40 to -0.55 computed locally (no Alpaca greeks on 0DTE)
Bid/ask <= $0.03; debit <= 0.5% of equity; max 3 scalps/day; 2 consecutive losses ends the day
Shares the same daily 0DTE loss limit of -1.5% of equity with the call scalp
management_rules: Take profit at +35% of debit (slightly wider than the call version because downside moves travel further)
Trail after +35%: stop to +12%, then in 10% steps
exit_rules: Sell to close at +35%, -35%, or 15 minutes elapsed
Hard flatten at 15:45 ET. An ITM 0DTE put auto-exercises into a SHORT 100-share position overnight - an uncovered short equity position the account is not approved to carry
Abandon worthless contracts rather than paying to exit
assignment_risk: No assignment (long). Auto-exercise of an ITM long put creates a short stock position, which is worse than the call case. 15:45 ET flatten is mandatory.
common_mistakes: Buying puts after the flush is already over (chasing the third red 5-min bar); ignoring that IV crush after a V-bottom reversal kills the put faster than delta does.
zero_dte_notes: In backtests, long 0DTE puts generally outperform long 0DTE calls because downside realized vol exceeds the implied path more often than upside does. Still net-negative expectancy without a filter.
